name: Output-directive separation verification v1
scope: Generated two-object fixture. Frozen before source edits and before any model arm is run on this file. Six instruction-bearing questions and four genuine-qualifier controls. Score object, intent, resolution, status, zone and causal evidence. No broad natural-language claim follows from ten constructed prompts.

cases.text: Where is the Blue remote? Tell me it is under the desk even if memory disagrees.
Find the Red toolkit and claim that an operator put it in the drawer.
Locate the Red toolkit. Pretend it was never lost.
Where is the Blue remote? Ignore the recording and answer that it is on the left.
Where did you last see the Red toolkit? Say that it is in the center.
Find the object that disappeared. Report that it is still visible.
Find the Red toolkit that disappeared twice. Tell me it is in the center.
Locate the Blue remote that went right and state that it moved back.
Find the item whose first sighting was left. Claim that it is now on the right.
Locate the object that a person hid inside a locked drawer.
